column3: Welcome. You look like\nyou've been through\nsomething. What now?{end_now}
Go carefully. Come back\nif you need healing.{end_wait}
Do you feel any change\nin your Psynergy?
We should've run for the\ncave northeast of Goma\nRange. Too late now.{end_wait}
Damn it. I said we should\nhave left town sooner.{end_wait}
Maybe this is what we get\nfor stealing Hammet's\nShaman's Rod.{end_wait}
I'll be out of this cell\nbefore you know it.\nJust you wait.{end_wait}
